name: AXM Hermes Runtime Adapter
actions: verify reviewed upstream Hermes origin commit tree version and clean worktree
fetch only the exact pinned upstream snapshot rather than floating branch history
install pinned upstream dependencies only on explicit deps command
start Hermes with uv no-sync and Hermes runtime lazy dependency installation disabled
prepare or repair AXM-owned Hermes hooks memory skill and background-review controls while backing up conflicting local config
default built-in Hermes memory and automatic background review off and gate skill/memory writes
launch each Hermes process inside a fresh AXM run capsule with a bounded wall-clock watchdog
strip inherited secrets and remote provider credentials according to local provider-egress policy
layer Hermes native write-safe-root underneath AXM fail-closed path and capability checks
enforce research versus operator posture before every Hermes tool dispatch
fail closed on missing authority unknown tools unverifiable file paths or exhausted limits
write metadata-only hashed tool provider and session evidence receipts
finalize each process into a candidate-only AXM Return Packet
repair orphaned incomplete runs into recovery Return Packets
serve the preserved loopback proposal-control layer
summary: Pinned external Hermes Agent with AXM research/operator authority, bounded learning, credential egress guard, layered write controls, wall-clock watchdog, per-run evidence capsules, Return Packets, and deterministic repair.
notes: Hermes remains external MIT donor/runtime code. Credential stripping is not network isolation; hook authorization is not an OS sandbox; watchdog termination is not a process-tree kill guarantee. Default posture is research, action consent is OFF, provider credentials are local-only, runtime lazy installs/background review/built-in memory are OFF, and all mutation/world-action capabilities are OFF. Hermes outputs/memory/skills remain non-canonical candidates.
